C-CONSOLIDATION-369.Summary: Consolidate confirmed audit defects in authentication UI, review bulk writes and duplicated frontend code without changing schema or the canonical business workflow.
C-CONSOLIDATION-369.Problem: The 0.4.10 runtime retains unreachable frontend generations, system password prompts, silent Plan/Fact refresh failures and a bulk AI review path that can overwrite a newer non-empty meeting value. The backlog also contains historical contracts that conflict with the direct-completion model.

Goals.Goal: Keep the canonical flow source-first and direct-completion while removing only proven dead frontend modules.
Use masked application-owned dialogs for account password changes and administrator password reset without changing PIN/account authorization semantics.
Preserve a newer manual meeting date or protocol number when bulk AI repair is applied.
Expose Plan/Fact refresh failures and hide the technical template document type from the frequent path through existing progressive disclosure.

Constraints.Constraint: Exact base main is 36396a4b15b7be8902d6164846da9a51fa8c5407, issue authority is #369.
SQLite schema remains 31. Applied migrations, immutable document versions, blob hashes and extraction evidence are unchanged.
PIN setup/login, account roles, ACL checks, CSRF and password hashing are not weakened or replaced.
Bulk AI repair is explicit operator action and may fill only an empty target field or confirm the same current value; it must not overwrite a conflicting current value.
No new mandatory service, cloud dependency, LLM dependency or parallel task/document registry.
GRACE owns scope/lint for the high-risk auth/write change; project CI and targeted auth/browser tests own functional evidence.

NonGoals.NonGoal: New product features, schema migrations, release workflow redesign or changes to immutable evidence.
Replacing the existing PIN model or requiring account mode for normal local operation.
Claiming physical Astra Linux acceptance from GitHub CI.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unreachable lifecycle-next.js and plan-fact-origin.js are removed while lifecycle-safe and current Plan/Fact entry points remain intact.
Account password change uses masked current/new/confirmation fields with inline errors; administrator reset uses the same application-owned secret-dialog contract in the active path.
Cancellation does not mutate credentials and focus returns to the initiating control.
Bulk AI repair cannot overwrite a non-empty conflicting meeting date or protocol number; skipped review remains open.
Plan/Fact refresh/rebuild/card failures have an observable error state instead of an empty catch.
The template internal document type remains compatible but is under additional fields in the frequent wizard path.
npm run check, npm test, npm run smoke, existing auth regression and affected Plan/Fact/browser regressions pass on the exact PR head.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head project CI plus targeted authentication, review-write and Plan/Fact evidence; no schema migration gate because schema is unchanged.
